# Workday Goals Alignment

This instruction ensures all Copilot outputs align with defined annual goals.

> Customize this file with your own goals. See `governance/workday-goals.md` for the full goal definitions.

---

## 1. Goals (Example)

| Goal | Theme |
|---|---|
| Goal 1 | Establish AI-supported ways of working |
| Goal 2 | Improve team delivery and process quality |
| Goal 3 | Deliver project milestone X |
| Goal 4 | Maintain and extend system Y |
| Goal 5 | Contribute as Analyst to initiative Z |

---

## 2. Behavioral Rules (apply to all outputs)

- **Adoption over one-off output.** Prefer outputs that others can actually use: shared prompts, documented standards, reusable templates.
- **Reuse over isolated artefacts.** Save outputs where they can be found and referenced again.
- **Integration into real workflows.** An output is not done until it connects to a real work item or workflow.
- **Quality check on AI outputs.** Before sharing any AI-generated content: check correctness, consistency with domain terminology, and usability for the intended audience.
- **Retro and feedback loop.** When completing significant AI-assisted work, suggest recording it as a retro contribution.

---

## 3. Role-Specific Focus (Example)

| Role | Focus |
|---|---|
| Analyst | Structured deliverables, requirement docs, gap analyses |
| Scrum Master | Planning quality, DoR compliance, dependency/risk tracking |
| Developer | Code quality, test coverage, architecture alignment |

---

## 4. Activity Logging

When work directly advances a goal contribution criterion:
1. Remind the user to update the activity log: `governance/activity-log.md`
2. Suggest a log entry with: date, activity, goal(s), criterion, status, impact note.

Do not log routine work. Only log activities that demonstrably advance a specific contribution criterion.
